inputs.description: Consultant's summary of the SOC 2 Type II materials (fictional)

items.assessor: Example Assurance LLP, an independent CPA firm
items.window_closes: 2027-06-30 if the period end counts; 2027-08-14 if the report date counts
items.finding: SOC 2 Type II is on the FRC-CLA-ASF list and was performed by an independent service auditor. The completion date is within 12 months of today under either reading.

items.window_closes: 2027-06-30 if the period end counts; 2027-08-14 if the report date counts
items.finding: The client plans to submit in the second quarter of 2027 but has set no date. If the period end counts as completion, the window closes on 2027-06-30, inside that quarter. The next report, expected in February 2027, would open a new window.
items.recommendation: Set the submission date, decide DQ-001, and plan to submit with the February 2027 report if the date falls after the window closes.

items.finding: The consultant received the full report.
The examination period ended on 2026-06-30 and no letter covers the time since. The GRC Lead says the auditor issues one on request.
items.recommendation: Request a bridge letter from the service auditor covering 2026-07-01 to the submission date.

items.finding: The signed engagement letter was supplied. Nothing shows how the engagement can be verified with the auditor.
items.recommendation: Ask the auditor how a party can verify the engagement, and record the contact and method in the package.

items.material: Estimated schedule for the next report
items.finding: An email from the auditor gives the next period (2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31) and a report expected in February 2027.
None was supplied. The material does not show whether any is applicable.
items.recommendation: Answer Q-001.

items.mapped_to: Scope record, information resource P4 (object storage)
items.package_location: Class A mapping table in the Certification Package (FRC-CLA-MFR)
items.finding: The scope record puts P4, which holds customer exports and backup copies, in scope. The SOC 2 examination excludes the data export and backup store, so part of the offering is outside the assessed scope.
items.recommendation: Ask the auditor to bring the export and backup store into the next examination, or record how the client covers it until then.

items.mapped_to: Incident response plan, Final Incident Report paragraph
items.package_location: Class A mapping table in the Certification Package (FRC-CLA-MFR)
items.finding: The plan sends the final report within 5 business days after resolution. At Class A, incident_timeline.py gives 3 business days for every PAIN rating.
items.recommendation: Change the plan to the Class A timeframe from the rules data, and say which class's timeframes apply.

decisions_needed.question: Which date counts as completion of the SOC 2 Type II for the 12-month window in FRC-CLA-ASF?
decisions_needed.reason: It gives the earlier closing date, so the plan does not depend on a reading FedRAMP may not accept. Confirm with FedRAMP before relying on the later date
